Draft for legal review. This describes how Klin is designed to work and has not yet been reviewed by a lawyer or checked against the finished app. Text in square brackets is still to be filled in.

Last updated 13 November 2026

Using Klin

Klin is a private app for two people. By creating an account you agree to these terms and to our Privacy Policy. You must be 18 or over and able to enter into a binding agreement.

Your account

Keep your sign-in details safe. You are responsible for what happens under your account. Tell us if you think someone else has got into it.

Your space

A space has exactly two members, and each person can be in one active space at a time. Joining needs both people to agree. Either of you can leave at any time. We will show you what happens to shared content before you confirm.

What you share

What you write and upload stays yours. You give us permission to store it, process it and show it to your partner as needed to run Klin, and nothing more. Only share things you have the right to share.

What is not allowed

Please do not use Klin to harass, threaten, stalk or monitor another person, to share illegal content or content involving anyone under 18, to impersonate someone, or to attack or misuse the service. You can report content in the app. We may suspend accounts that break these rules.

The assistant

The assistant offers suggestions and is not a substitute for professional advice. It is not a therapist and does not diagnose. It can be wrong. If you are in danger or need urgent help, contact local emergency services.

Klin Plus

Klin Plus is an optional subscription bought through the App Store or Google Play. Price, billing period and any free trial are shown before you confirm, and nothing is charged without your confirmation. It renews automatically until you cancel in your store account. If either partner subscribes, Plus covers both members of the space for as long as the subscription is active. [Refund and trial terms to be completed.]

If a subscription ends, nothing you saved is deleted. Features that need Plus stop being available for new content.

Availability and changes

We work to keep Klin running but cannot promise it will always be available or error free. We may change or stop features, and we will give notice of important changes.

Ending your account

You can delete your account in the app at any time. We may suspend or close an account that breaks these terms, and we will tell you why unless the law says we cannot.
